title: Installation Jobs: Credit Share After Customer Reschedules
content:
**Share granted after the customer's own reschedules — Installation Jobs**

The customer's own reschedules of an **Installation Jobs** record, failed-access visits included, set the share of the company reschedule credit granted. The share multiplies the credit as a whole.

| Customer reschedules recorded on the job | Share granted |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | 0.8 |
| exactly one | 0.9 |
| none | one |

The count is of reschedules recorded on the job as caused by the customer; a failed-access visit is recorded as a customer reschedule and counts. Reschedules caused by the company or by the weather do not count.

## Worked examples (hypothetical inputs)

| Customer reschedules on the job | Credit figure | Credit after the share |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | 200.00 | 200.00 |
| 1 (a failed-access visit) | 200.00 | 180.00 |
| 3 | 200.00 | 160.00 |
